description: Source code for the 'print-flaky-tests' command class, which generates a report of flaky tests based on a flakiness dashboard, including methods for collecting expectation lines, filtering build types, and executing the command.

classes.name: FlakyTests
classes.description: A command class that prints flaky tests based on flakiness dashboard data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FlakyTests command, setting up the expectations factory.

methods.name: _filter_build_type_specifiers
methods.description: Filters out build type specifiers from a list, excluding those in TestExpectations.BUILD_TYPES.

methods.name: _collect_expectation_lines
methods.description: Collects expectation lines from builder names using a factory, merging models, and filtering specifiers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to run the command: collects expectation lines, filters tests, and prints the report.
